title: orm recipe
description: The recipe format of docs/spec/feature-coverage.md (FCV-2 to FCV-4). A recipe with a fixture expects exactly mysql, postgres and sqlite; a recipe without one expects exactly none.

version.description: The version of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

note.description: The note of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

fixture.description: A dbspec-set.json document set, or none: the cases of a recipe with fixture none run on an empty case database (FCV-3).

schema.description: The schema manifest that the ir.validate steps check their requests against, relative to the recipe file.

textLine.description: A line of a dbspec.format text, or a form that a helper expands to lines, so that a long document need not be written out in full: repeat gives its lines count times with {var} replaced by from, from + 1, ...; fill gives one line of its text repeated count times.

model.description: The model name as the generator spells it, such as CompositeAccount (FCV-4).

install.description: false: the helper installs no fixture before the steps, which install it with schema.install (statement_events).

value.description: A recipe wrapper: one key that names the form of the value.

f64.description: A non-finite binary64 number (the bind vectors of tests/bind/vectors.json); a finite one is a float wrapper.

caseId.description: A case id: a name whose hyphens name the case of a plan vector (tests/dbspec/plan-*.json).

encodeArgument.description: The value of codec.encode: an argument, or an ordered_json wrapper, the ordered-json value of its value whatever the stages (FCV-4).

expect.description: The outcome of each database: exactly mysql, postgres and sqlite, or exactly none; the root selects which.

steps.description: An empty transaction is a statement-free BEGIN and COMMIT.

audit.description: The audit values of the transaction, column names of the audit record table and their values; an empty object is an audit transaction with no value of its own (CFG-8, DSL-126).

isolation.description: The isolation level of the transaction; a nested transaction that names one is refused with CONFIG.

read_only.description: A read-only transaction; a nested transaction that names it is refused with CONFIG.

dsn.description: The DSN of the case database for case, otherwise the DSN text of the step (FCV-4).

Absent: the case database. "case" is its DSN, "case-socket" its MySQL DSN through the socket ORM_TEST_MYSQL_SOCKET (CFG-10, CFG-19; a MySQL-only recipe unit, FCV-3); otherwise the DSN text of the step (FCV-4).

audit_source.description: The audit source of the connection (CFG-8): the values it returns, or fail, a source whose own error fails the transaction.

schema.description: The schema manifest of the request, relative to the recipe file.

input.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by schema.

lines.description: A schema text, one string per line (docs/spec/dbspec.md).
A plan text, one string per line (docs/spec/plans.md).

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

text.description: The plan text of EmitPlan: the lines of the plan, each ended by a newline.

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

steps.description: The steps of PlanSteps in order, each the object of docs/spec/plans.md (Steps).

request.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by the schema key of the recipe.

chain.description: The case of tests/markdown/cases.json that the chain runs (tests/markdown/README.md).

answer.description: The answer of the chain's one request, as the case gives it (docs/spec/protocol.md section 5, Read).

answers.description: The answers of a transaction chain keyed by the op of each control message and the kind of each request.

value.description: The result of the chain in the plain JSON form of tests/markdown/README.md, a row, a list, a count, a value or {error, runs}.

params.description: The params of the one request that the listener received (PRT-66, PRT-67), in the JSON form of PRT-67; the now of the message is not compared.

column.description: A parameter slot of the bind fixture (tests/bind/slots.dbs): <table>.<column>. The statement reads that column with the operator and one parameter.

operator.description: eq compares the column with the parameter through the chain method without an operator; like_contains compares it with the pattern that contains the parameter (the transform of tests/bind/vectors.json); eq_method, ne_method and gt_method call the chain method of the operator Eq, Ne or Gt.

params.description: The one parameter of the statement, a recipe wrapper.

process_zone.description: An IANA zone name that is the process default zone while the case runs, restored after it. An offset-less datetime is a wall clock in the connection zone, not in this zone (docs/spec/protocol.md section 5).

begin.description: A transaction begin on the connection, sent in place of a statement.

message.description: The JSON that the listener receives first: the begin message of a begin, or the JSON of the parameter of a statement (runtime value model, docs/spec/protocol.md section 5), or the empty list `[]` of a statement that binds no parameter (a nil compared with eq is IS NULL, DSL-48).

error.description: The code of the error that the public call returns before any message is sent.

model.description: The generated model of the bind fixture (tests/bind/slots.dbs).

column.description: A column of the model, set through its public setter.

value.description: A recipe wrapper, the value that the setter takes.

message.description: The JSON of the one parameter of the insert statement.

refused.description: The database must refuse the statement; the step fails when it succeeds. A driver error of any code passes.

refused_message.description: With refused: the text that the error message of the driver holds, compared in lower case, so that a refusal for another reason fails the step.

column_name.description: The name that replaces the name of the first column of the descriptor of the page.

rows_sequence.description: count rows whose column runs from `from`, each with values (a batch-limit case states its size, not its rows).

from.description: The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.
The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.

pick.description: The fields of each result row that the expect names; a field the expect does not name is not compared.

connect.description: The related model is connected to the connection of the query; without it the related model takes the connection of its parent (INT-87).

many.description: relations(child): the result is a collection, one output row per child row (INT-87).

alias.description: The result name, given through the generated alias method of the child and read through its generated getter.

lock.description: The row lock of the query; outside a transaction it is refused with CONFIG.

tuples.description: The rows whose key columns equal one tuple of values (DSL-82, the generated tuple filter of a composite key).

page.description: The query reads one page by GetsPage: offset/limit+1 of size limit, with the total of the rows (INT-36).

from.description: The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.

pick.description: The fields of each result row that the expect names; a field the expect does not name is not compared.

compile.description: The query is read by getQuery: its text and binds, not its rows.

masks.description: The bind values no recipe can fix, per database, by event and bind position: a random nonce or the clock, named in value.

schema.description: The .dbs manifest of the generation, relative to the recipe file.

schema_replace.description: A text of the document of schema and the text that replaces it before the generation, so that one document holds the column names that the generator refuses.

used.description: Other document sets that the generation uses, relative to the recipe file.

before.description: Another set's output that the generation follows: the .dbs manifest schema, relative to the recipe file, generated first into output, with the scan of the source directory scan.

sources.description: The scanned sources of each runtime language, each a tree of path to text.

text.description: Texts that the generated files of the set hold together, and texts that they do not hold.

message.description: A text that the error contains.

position.description: The source position of a file that does not parse (DSL-152): its line, and its column where the parser gives one.

text.description: The lines of a dbspec document, joined with LF and a final LF (docs/spec/mermaid.md).

set.description: The other documents of the set that the text uses, by name, each the lines of a document joined as text is.

document.description: A .dbs file, relative to the recipe file.

value.description: A subset of {mermaid: <text>, dropped: [[kind, table, name], ...]}, plain JSON; the keys it names are compared.

mermaid.description: The Mermaid text, or a ref to the mermaid of an export.

name.description: The name of the imported document.

skeleton_of.description: A .dbs file, relative to the recipe file, whose tables, columns, primary keys and foreign keys the import must return.

value.description: A subset of {document, dropped, same_skeleton} or {errors}, plain JSON; the keys it names are compared.

columns.description: The columns of the restored row that the rows expect compares.

model.chain.description: Builds a query without running it, bound by `as`: a later query, count or page continues it through `from`.

message_suffix.description: The text that the error message ends with.

json.description: The result of a model op of the table path, as plain JSON: rows as objects in the order the query returned them, a scalar as itself (FCV-4).

oneOf.description: Explicit connectors in order: [connector, predicate] or a bare [connector], whose next condition has no connector of its own (DSL-7).
The condition of a join, placed in the WHERE of the query where this item stands; names the join by its `as`.
The rows whose columns equal one tuple: [columns, tuples] (DSL-82).

match.description: The pair [column of the query, column of the joined model].

many.description: relations(child): the result is a collection (INT-87).

qualifiedName.description: A name, or a dotted name: alias.column of a joined model (FCV-4 query fields) or a dotted local name (utils.set_local).

dsn.description: A DSN: sqlite_file absent names a SQLite file that the case does not create; url is a DSN text that no dialect serves.

only.description: The databases that run a step or a case; a step or a case without it runs on every database.
